bio: Find a table on the spacious terrace of this modern winery to enjoy wonderful views out across the vineyard and the hills; on a warm summer’s day, it doesn’t get much better than this. The well-curated wine list covers Hungary and Europe, and includes reds and rosés from the vines you see in front of you, as well as whites from the owners’ other winery in Tokaj. The concise selection of contemporary dishes take their inspiration from the Hungarian kitchen but exhibit a level of refined creativity. The passionate team will share their knowledge to help you find the perfect wine match....
